title: Drafts & scheduled posts
notes: Save a topic as a draft and finish it later — title, body, category, tags, cover and poll are all kept, in a new “Drafts” page in your account menu. Or schedule a post to publish itself at a date and time you pick, and Convoro posts it for you automatically.

changelog.text: Drafts: save a topic as a draft (title, body, category, tags, cover image and poll all kept) and finish it later from the new “Drafts” page in your account menu.
Scheduled posts: choose a date and time for a topic to publish itself — Convoro posts it for you automatically.
